verdict.rationale: The pack never mentions SCIM or outbound provisioning of users, groups, or entitlements into downstream apps when access is assigned. The closest items describe generic identity lifecycle automation, HRIS-sourced onboarding, and API bulk operations. These are inbound or adjacent features, so they earn no credit for this applicable IdP axis.

support.subject: As an IT admin, accounts create themselves — SCIM provisioning pushes users, groups, and entitlements into downstream apps the moment access is assigned
